text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre hasn't shown up, even though it's 
time for training. While searching around 
the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your tail is so pretty~! Hey, hey, 
can I touch it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...This is the King's tail. Handle it with 
due reverence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I cautioned her, who had been 
playfully fooling around with the 
children, to be more careful in the 
future."
